APNEP Data Inventory Conflicts Viewer

Conflict pairs map the spatial overlap between human-use pressures and ecological or community resources across the Albemarle-Pamlico region, on a ~5 km² hex grid (H3 resolution 7) with a 3×3 bivariate classification.

How to use

  • Pick a category, then a pressure–resource pairing.
  • Use Show conflict hotspots to filter cells where pressure and resource are both High (biv_class 9).
  • Each map carries its own legend for the layer colors.

Reading the colors

  • Pressure runs pale-to-strong purple (left to right).
  • Resource runs pale-to-medium green (bottom to top).
  • The 3×3 overlap darkens to dark indigo — high pressure AND high resource, the conflict hotspots.

Conflict pairs

Boat Traffic vs. SAV · Fishing vs. Closures or Energy Development · Tourism vs. Resident Access · Roads and Ferries vs. Flooding · Agriculture vs. Saltwater Intrusion · Shoreline Protection vs. Wetland Migration · Conservation vs. Tribal / Local Access

Method notes

Layers are aggregated per hex in EPSG:32119, classified into Low / Medium / High terciles on non-zero cells, and exported in WGS84. Data are provided without warranty; users are responsible for using the data in a manner consistent with the limitations of geospatial data.
How to use: pick a category, then a pairing. Chart slices highlight Low / Medium / High cells (3×3 bivariate classification).
